title: Issues with nightly build 2021.08.01
body: The glycemic value is not shown on the main screen; and in the system notification. Even if the sensor is active. However you can see the sensor readings from the graph. The nightly build is that of August 1st.

comments.body: Please try to revert to [2021.07.17](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/tag/2021.07.17) and report if the problem went away. If you have time, please test [2021.07.31](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/tag/2021.07.31) as well.
I tried the 2021.07.31 and in this version I do not have this problem
@nathan990315 Can you let me know which handset model and android version this is with? thanks
Nokia X20 and Android 11

The same issue for me, Dexcom G5, Google Pixel 4a 5G with Android 12.

The numeric value wasn't updated but the graph was and for a while AndroidAPS was receiving the readings from xDrip matching with the graph dots values.

@parapenT1sta The main glucose value wasn't updated or it wasn't showing at all?

I'm preparing a new version I would like you both to try to see if you get the same issue.
@jamorham The graph dots were being updated and working fine, only the value on the top right was stuck to the value I had before the update.
@jamorham I will test the new version as soon you release it.

@parapenT1sta @nathan990315 Please try the latest nightly, it is also available here: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/download/2021.08.02/xDrip-plus-20210802-0af3ba0.apk
If it doesn't work just roll back to the 31st July version by simply installing that over the top.
In the new version this problem has been solved for me
Working fine here. Thank you!
Hat leider nicht funktioniert, habe wieder auf den Bau vom 31.07 zurück gesetzt.
@Thomas-Wolff Which problem do you have? You did not posted in this issue before. Please report your complete environment and potential log entries.

@Thomas-Wolff Please write in English! If you don't speak English, use https://www.deepl.com/de/translator. It is much simpler if the creator of the comment translates the text just once instead of every issue worker.

Sorry, The blood glucose data table and calibration table could not be called up. I then immediately reset to the build from 31.07 without carrying out any further tests - looked to me like the same problem as the build from 01.08.
@Thomas-Wolff Thanks, this is a separate but related issue which I can reproduce and will correct immediately.

Thanks for the information, I will now continue with the construction from 31.07 as it is going very well.
Greetings Thomas
